children: Ukrainian President President Volodymyr Zelenskiy has asked neighbours Poland, Romania, Slovakia and Hungary to allow the transit of Ukrainian grain cargoes due to a Black Sea blockade, Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar said on Saturday.

Magyar, who agreed with Zelenskiy to reset Ukraine-Hungary ties at a bilateral meeting on Friday, said he would have no objections to the measure if the Ukrainian grain cargoes only passed through Hungary, private broadcaster RTL reported.
